% Delta r (loss of approximation ratio, % of the energy range) vs T-count reduction, p = 3, 48 SK instances.
% Data: ../results/numbers.tex (generated by scripts/make_numbers.py). Build: xelatex fig_tradeoff.tex
\documentclass[border=3pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{fontspec}
\IfFontExistsTF{Times New Roman}{\setmainfont{Times New Roman}}{}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\definecolor{bpC}{HTML}{2A78D6}
\definecolor{cluC}{HTML}{EB6834}
\definecolor{ink}{HTML}{222222}
\definecolor{muted}{HTML}{777777}
\definecolor{gridc}{HTML}{E4E4E2}
\input{../results/numbers.tex}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\footnotesize]
\begin{axis}[width=9.5cm, height=5.6cm, ymode=log, xmin=1.5, xmax=5.5, ymin=0.1, ymax=10,
  xtick={2,3,4,5}, ytick={0.1,0.3,1,3,10}, yticklabels={0.1,0.3,1,3,10},
  xlabel={$T$-count reduction vs.\ per-term rotation (value, $B{=}16$)}, ylabel={$\Delta r$ (\% of energy range)},
  axis line style={muted}, tick style={muted, line width=0.4pt}, tick align=outside, major tick length=2pt,
  ticklabel style={font=\scriptsize, text=ink}, xmajorgrids, ymajorgrids, major grid style={gridc, line width=0.4pt},
  label style={font=\scriptsize}, axis x line*=bottom, axis y line*=left, clip=false,
  bp/.style={only marks, mark=*, mark size=2.2pt, bpC, mark options={draw=white, line width=0.4pt}},
  cl/.style={only marks, mark=square*, mark size=2pt, cluC, mark options={draw=white, line width=0.4pt}}]
\draw[ink, densely dotted, line width=0.6pt] (axis cs:1.5,\layerGain) -- (axis cs:5.5,\layerGain) node[pos=0.02, above right, font=\scriptsize, text=ink, inner sep=1pt] {gain of layer 3 (median)};
\foreach \x/\m/\q in {\TredBPone/\drMedBPone/\drNinetyBPone, \TredBPtwo/\drMedBPtwo/\drNinetyBPtwo, \TredBPthree/\drMedBPthree/\drNinetyBPthree}
  {\edef\tmp{\noexpand\draw[bpC, line width=0.8pt] (axis cs:\x,\m) -- (axis cs:\x,\q);}\tmp}
\foreach \x/\m/\q in {\TredCluster/\drMedCluster/\drNinetyCluster, \TredGrid/\drMedGrid/\drNinetyGrid}
  {\edef\tmp{\noexpand\draw[cluC, line width=0.8pt] (axis cs:\x,\m) -- (axis cs:\x,\q);}\tmp}
\addplot[bp] coordinates {(\TredBPone,\drMedBPone)} node[font=\scriptsize, text=ink, anchor=west, inner sep=3pt] {BP1};
\addplot[bp] coordinates {(\TredBPtwo,\drMedBPtwo)} node[font=\scriptsize, text=ink, anchor=west, inner sep=3pt] {BP2};
\addplot[bp] coordinates {(\TredBPthree,\drMedBPthree)} node[font=\scriptsize, text=ink, anchor=west, inner sep=3pt] {BP3};
\addplot[cl] coordinates {(\TredCluster,\drMedCluster)} node[font=\scriptsize, text=ink, anchor=east, inner sep=3pt] {CLUSTER$_4$};
\addplot[cl] coordinates {(\TredGrid,\drMedGrid)} node[font=\scriptsize, text=ink, anchor=west, inner sep=3pt] {GRID$_4$};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
